sleepChoiceChecks.interpretation: Distance and reservation order explain these choices; different quiet/curious personalities do not change the selected equal-type bed from the same position. Room access applies to both beds in one room; it is not a bed-owner or priority field.

daily.control: Both travel from home forest to landing at 08:00, work once, return and eat. A returning diner who encounters the occupied single hearth receives explicit five-minute waits and retries through the core API; the wait command is not exposed by current UI options. Autonomous life follows until 20:00. The currently active tasks are cancelled via public API, with transit safely completed. Kaya requests mat-1, Sui requests the same and is rejected, then takes the other mat. Autonomous life resumes through next 08:00.
daily.caution: This is an API scenario and UI-source reading, not an actual browser interaction. Changing active resident resets the uncommitted selector in current UI source; no UI re-selection count is claimed as a measured click count. The forced 20:00 rest starts with energy above 80; it is a controlled simultaneous-use probe, not a claim that autonomous residents would choose bed at 20:00.
